title: Part 6: The Bank Encounter Game
author: J.W.
excerpt: The /bank route was architected as a four-phase cinematic experience: lobby introduction with glassmorphism story card, full-motion video transition, numbers matching puzzle game with lives system and sound effects, and an unlocked phase celebrating victory. Each phase designed with narrative continuity, accessible UX, and deployment-first asset management. The first playable game loop is complete.
